title: A Prom for the Playlist
author: Dominic Blackwood
blurb: Freya Thornbury, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
